- Rachel closed Zest Grocers' Zendesk ticket for the 12/11 incident after their confirmation [6].

## What is still open
- **PR #247 and 13/11 replay (Orbitly & Zest):** You traced Orbitly's ~8% iOS funnel drop to `kestrel-ios/3.2.0` sending per-session sequence numbers as `event_id`, which caused #240's dedupe to drop 1,179,950 legitimate Orbitly events and 3,812 Zest pilot events since 13/11, and opened PR #247 to key on `(project_id, device_id, event_id)` [1]. - **Ingest DLQ alert due before Friday (20/11):** Noa finalized the 12/11 postmortem in #233 for Friday's incident review [3], and the prep meeting assigned you an action item before the review to add an alert when the ingest dead-letter queue exceeds 1,000 messages [7].
- **iOS SDK 3.2.1 UUID revert:** `kestrel-ios` still needs to restore UUID `event_id`s in 3.2.1 for other consumers relying on global uniqueness; you have a draft note ready for the iOS team [1].
